newsitem.title: USA: Maine association urges cut in property taxes.
newsitem.headline: Maine association urges cut in property taxes.

text.p: NEW YORK, Nov 12 (Reuter) The Maine Municipal Association wants lawmakers to rewrite Maine's tax mix to lower property taxes and shift the tax burden to other taxes.
While many lawmakers say they are willing to look for a tax package that accomplishes the group's goal, they caution the legislature may not have the time to get the job done.
Gov. Angus King said the major problem is that one person's tax shift means another person's tax increase.
